Figure_6_training_seed_variation: Figure 6. Training-seed variation of the domain-configured detectors. All five completed runs are shown in each cohort. Filled circles identify the post-hoc selected seeds: 1/3/4 for DENTEX2023 and 0/2/3 for Mobile and DSLR; open circles show the remaining runs. Diamonds and squares show the selected-three and all-five means, respectively, with sample-standard-deviation bars. (A) DENTEX2023. (B) Mobile. (C) DSLR. Independent AP-axis ranges display within-cohort variation. The selected-three summaries are exploratory and do not represent prespecified repeated-seed evidence. All-five and fixed-0/1/2 results are reported in the supplementary tables.
Figure_7_Mobile_framework_AP: Figure 7. Framework-level detection AP on Mobile images. The blue diamond shows DENT-STRIDE-Mobile with K=4 and temperature 0.50 for the post-hoc selected seeds 0/2/3 (55.459 ± 0.275 AP); the purple square shows all five completed seeds (55.292 ± 0.301 AP). Error bars indicate sample standard deviation. The two repeated-seed official controls retain their original seeds 0/1/2; open circles identify single-seed external results without dispersion estimates. All external systems, including RT-DETR-L, are retained. These recipe-level validation comparisons use framework-specific resolution, pretraining, optimization, and post-processing and do not establish statistical superiority or an isolated prototype-temperature effect.
Figure_9_Pano_prior_comparison: Figure 9. Same-checkpoint anatomical scoring on DENTEX2023. All five checkpoints are evaluated with no prior, center-only, shape-only, and combined scoring from candidates before top-k selection. Circles show actual runs; diamonds show the post-hoc selected seeds 1/3/4 and squares show all-five summaries, with sample-standard-deviation bars. (A) AP. (B) AR100. Center-only and joint scoring change selected-three mean AP by +0.595 and +0.563 points; the corresponding all-five changes are +0.555 and +0.523 points. Weights are fixed within each seed, so the comparison concerns inference scoring rather than training effects.
Figure_S3_prior_paired_AP: Figure S3. Paired changes in DENTEX2023 AP relative to no prior. Each circle represents one of the five same-checkpoint comparisons; filled circles identify post-hoc selected seeds 1/3/4 and open circles the other seeds. Diamonds and squares show selected-three and all-five mean changes, respectively, with sample-standard-deviation bars, not confidence intervals. All center, shape, and joint settings are retained; shape-only effects are small relative to center-only and joint effects. No selection-adjusted significance claim is made.
Figure_S8_learning_curves: Figure S8. Validation-AP trajectories over all 160 epochs. Thin grey lines show all five actual runs. No smoothing or synthetic intervals are applied. Epoch-wise means are not the mean of individually selected best checkpoints, and seed selection used the observed best-validation results.
